wgasc.status: Live · 2022–2026 real seasons (227 shows, 686 ensembles) with caption sheets
wgasc.captions: written — docs/wgasc/data/captions/ in DCI format: index.json cols [date,event,class,corps,ea,ma,da,ge,pen,tot] + per-year files; 7,511 rows = ~100% of color-guard result rows every season. Each row double-validated: caption totals must rebuild the printed total (±0.015) AND equal the official bridge score (±0.011); 71 rows dropped (mostly 0.0-score exhibition entries, 3 test rows, a few ambiguous ties). Scale caveat for the renderer: regional sheets score EA/MA/DA/GE out of 25 each; championship sheets use doubled panels — EA/MA/DA out of 20, GE out of 40 — so per-caption trends jump scale at finals (compare within sheet type or normalize to share-of-total). Percussion & Winds divisions use different sheets (Music/Effect Music etc.) and are not captioned.
wgasc.notes: DATA: docs/wgasc/data/ complete in the exact usbands/DCI pipeline contract (meta, rankings, seasons/<y>, corps_index+corps/, profiles (monogram data-URIs #logo.svg), champions, records, db/, captions/, upcoming=[], LIVE marker, live_store.json). 227 events, 9,515 result rows, 686 ensembles, 568 standings rows (season 2026, complete — winter runs Jan–Apr). All hard gates verified by script: scores within 10–100, ranks sequential (recomputed after merging class flights), no duplicate ensemble rows, standings sorted, captions cross-checked against season scores. SCRAPER: scraper/scrape_wgasc.py (--ingest --all | --year Y | --assemble | --no-captions); scores come from bridge JSON (GetCompetitionsBySeason→GetCompetition), captions from per-round recap .htm pages; everything rate-limited + gzip-cached under data/raw/bridge.competitionsuite.com and data/raw/recaps.competitionsuite.com (~1,700 pages) so reruns are free. MECHANISM FINDINGS: no org GUID exists on any surface (recaps, season JSON, bridge endpoints all probed — GetSeasons needs an org GUID and no alternate endpoint leaks one), so SEASONS is a hard-coded GUID map in the scraper. New seasons discovered here: 2022 f8b3ccf7-a5ca-4d7d-aced-94bf45722546 (47), 2023 8b091ea8-820d-4e86-b505-081572aa5c07 (48), 2024 2c02537b-691f-442f-950f-4409e152d1b6 (46), via Wayback-seeded recap GUIDs; 2025/2026 from the probe report. 2021 GUID exists but holds 0 scored comps (COVID). Pre-2021 is unreachable from here: wgasc.org score pages weren't archived 2013–2020 and the bridge has no discovery path; 2004–2012 exist only as inline .aspx pages/PDFs in Wayback (separate salvage job). New-season seeding (annual manual step): one Google-indexed recap/schedule GUID from any 2027 event → GetCompetition returns the seasonGuid → add to SEASONS. EDITORIAL DECISIONS: single app includes the circuit's Percussion/Winds divisions as prefixed classes (guard first in class_order) — hence ensemble terms; class labels normalized (WGASC HS/JH → High School/Junior High, flight/(FINALS) suffixes stripped; Scholastic A and High School A are genuinely different divisions); generic comp names ("Color Guard") get "@ venue" suffixes for uniqueness; event URLs point at the public competition recap page. Champions = winner at the latest circuit championship event per class per season; ADLA (guest league) and SoNev (division) championships kept as events but excluded from titles; "Website Test Event" (2023, DELETE GROUP rows) excluded; Exhibition/Classification rounds skipped. Spot-checks: Arcadia HS's 2022–26 Scholastic World titles match the circuit's known record. GAPS: recap-vs-bridge name drift handled by unique-total join adopting the bridge name; ~9 real caption rows/season unmatchable (ties/units missing from bridge) were dropped, never guessed. rankings.json recent_events = championships (season complete). Integrator: add the config entry + PAGES/modes wiring; captions render is not yet enabled for family apps in the engine (FAM branch redirects #/captions) — data is ready when that ships.

tcgc.captions: written — docs/tcgc/data/captions/ (index.json + 13 year files, 15,258 rows) in DCI format with TCGC column vocabulary: cols = [date,event,class,corps,eq,mv,dsg,ge1,ge2,ge,pa,em,ev,oe,ma,mus,va,vis,perf,art,pen,tot]. Guard sheets fill eq/mv/dsg/ge1/ge2/ge; percussion fills em/ev/mus/vis (concert perc: mus/art); winds fills oe/ma/va; 2013-era legacy sheets fill ge/pa/vis and perf/art; unused columns are null per row. Every row is arithmetically reconciled against the sheet's own Sub Total/Total columns (some sheets scale caption sum ×1.25 — handled); non-reconciling rows are dropped, so a mis-parse can never surface as a wrong score. Spot cross-checks of caption totals vs bridge scores: 177/177 match. Note: ge1/ge2 are null on single-GE-judge sheets; the family engine currently hides the Captions tab for family apps and its CAPTION_DEFS list only knows DCI keys, so the integrator must add TCGC labels when wiring the tab.

tcgc.notes: DATA IN PLACE: docs/tcgc/data/ (LIVE marker set, meta.json updated with real UTC timestamp) — 401 events, ~15.3k result rows, 768 ensembles, 13 seasons. Scraper: scraper/scrape_tcgc.py (imports scrape_compsuite for the bridge base URL + score-cell regexes; own recap parser because TCGC recap markup differs from DCI's). Season GUIDs 2013-2026 are committed in SEASONS (harvested from Wayback copies of texascolorguardcircuit.org/scores + a fresh Wayback save of /scores-and-recap I triggered 2026-08-08 to unlock 2026: season 31377389-96c0-4b5b-b26c-d2d7585556ae, 45 comps); --discover re-verifies them, --ingest-all rebuilds everything from the gzip cache (reruns are nearly free; all fetches rate-limited through common.fetch). VALIDATION: all gates pass — ranks sequential (results re-ranked by score after merging Red/Blue/White flight rounds of the same class), no duplicate unit rows per event/class (best outing kept), scores bounded 10-100 (drops logged; e.g. 2014 DNS 0.0 rows, solo-ensemble 9.0 ratings), standings sorted desc. GAPS/POLICY: 2021 absent by design — TCGC's COVID season published in-person PLACEMENTS only, no scores (verified via Wayback; the new site has a 2021 tab but no snapshot landed and no recap GUIDs exist on the old placements pages). 2013 'TCGC Circuit Percussion Championships' has 0 rounds on the bridge (log-skipped); 2020 season ended pre-championships (COVID) so no 2020 champions. champions.json uses state/circuit-level finals only: Regional-A-and-below classes end at parallel area/site championships (multiple winners), so they intentionally have no single champion entry; 2026 Scholastic World has no champion because the source shows no SW round at 2026 State (sole SW unit last competed Feb 21). Guests/exhibition tags stripped so identities thread; their judged scores count as outings. Solo & Ensemble / critique / clinic / festival rounds excluded. upcoming.json is empty (offseason; 2027 schedule unpublished). live_store.json (5.3MB) holds parsed events per season for incremental rebuilds, mirroring usbands. NEW-SEASON SEEDING (only recurring manual step): add the 2027 season GUID to SEASONS once one 2027 recap/schedule GUID is public — a Wayback save of https://texascolorguardcircuit.org/scores-and-recap works from anywhere (the site itself SiteGround-captchas cloud IPs; the bridge + recaps.competitionsuite.com are fully open). Caches written under data/raw/{web.archive.org,bridge.competitionsuite.com,recaps.competitionsuite.com}/. Also present in working tree but NOT mine: edits to docs/plus.html/plus.js from a parallel session — untouched.

uil.status: Live — 47 seasons: region Division ratings 2005–2025 (~24.7k performances, 1,742 bands) + state placements 1979–2025; ratings-not-scores model, all score fields null by design.
uil.captions: none — UIL publishes only Division ratings (three judge ratings + final) at region and judge ordinals at state; no caption point breakdowns exist, so no docs/uil/data/captions/ was written.
uil.notes: DATASET (all files at /home/user/Cadence-Labs/docs/uil/data/, LIVE marker written, meta.updated real UTC): 1,122 events, 24,745 result rows, 1,742 band identities, 47 seasons. Scraper: /home/user/Cadence-Labs/scraper/scrape_uil.py (`--ingest`, `--refresh` to force-refetch current season). All downloads gzip-cached under data/raw/www.texasmusicforms.com/ and data/raw/{www.,}smbc.uiltexas.org/ — reruns are free. SOURCES: (1) one CSV GET/season 2005–2026 from texasmusicforms.com (region contests, whole state); (2) smbc.uiltexas.org index (2025 state prelims+finals, all 6 conferences) and archives.htm (4,148 placements 1979–2024). RATINGS MODEL: every result/standings/db score field is null; region results carry rating (1–5 int), rating_label (Superior…Poor) and judge_ratings [3 ints]; state results carry placement; meta.json has series_kind:"rating", rating_labels map, and a score_note; corps_index series = [year, best rating, conference]; corps perfs carry rating/placement. VALIDATION: independent re-check of written files = 0 errors (ranks sequential incl. standard-competition ties, no dup band per event-class, ratings 1–5, standings sorted rating-then-name with sequential rank, scores all null). Champions spot-checked against the historical record (2024 6A Hebron, 2018 6A Vista Ridge, 1979 4A Round Rock; 6A correctly absent in pre-2021 odd years). INTEGRATOR — RATINGS DISPLAY MODE NEEDED ON THESE SURFACES (engine currently renders score3(null)="—"): scoreboard standings Score column (use rating_label; rows also carry state.prelims/state.finals placements for the current season), scoreboard trend chart (trend pairs are [date, rating 1–5]; y-axis should be inverted/labeled), event results Score column (show rating_label or placement), movers/battles intentionally empty, Bands tab "Best score" tiles (best=null; best_rating provided), Records tab (records.json top/finals empty by design — nothing rankable without scores), Leaders/Compare views (plot rating values), Database tab (rows are 8-element [year,date,event,band,class,place,null,rating] — current 7-column viewer ignores the trailing rating; add a Rating column). champions.json tiles work as-is (null score renders no score span). DATA DECISIONS: vendor test rows (Region 88/50, 'CutTime HS') dropped; DNA/blank (~5–35/yr) and DQ (1–5/yr) rows dropped; 2007–08 Region 12 double-entries deduped preferring the row whose final rating matches its own judge majority (17 conflicts); state co-champions kept — 2000 3A, 2003 1A, 2011 4A carry a "co" field in champions.json (the tile shows the first name; surface "co" if desired); 1,184 blank-place archive prelims rows kept as unplaced participants (place null, sorted after placed); 8 early-archive singleton ordinal groups (e.g. 1986 4A Prelims [17]) demoted to unplaced with published ordinal kept in placement; state events use nominal Nov 1/2 ISO sort dates with honest "November YYYY" display (archives publish no dates); conference "B" (4 rows, 1979–80s) kept as its own class. IDENTITY THREADING: (school, city-cluster) identities across 47 years; 139 school-name variant merges (person-forename/city-prefix/district-tag variants) guarded by a different-school blacklist (North/South/East/West/Lake/Life/Permian etc. never merge — Lake Travis HS ≠ Travis HS, North Forney ≠ Forney verified); same-name schools display city qualifiers (Bowie HS (Austin) vs (El Paso) etc.); non-varsity bands are separate "(NV)" identities; known residual splits: renamed schools thread as two identities (e.g. Midland Lee→Legacy), plus a couple of one-off variants ("S and S CISD HS"). 2026: CSV endpoint already live but holds only vendor test rows (season starts Oct 2026) — a scheduled rerun of `python3 scraper/scrape_uil.py --ingest --refresh` during Oct–Nov 2026 picks up new region ratings and the SMBC live page (which self-updates during championships week) automatically. Area-contest layer (~33 region-site PDFs) intentionally not ingested per probe verdict — bracketed by region CSV + state HTML. upcoming.json is [].

issma.notes: DATA: placements-only by design — ISSMA has hard-gated all scored results behind its Directors-Only login since 2005 (never bypassed; live scores would need ISSMA permission). Source is the public mbhistory.php (every State Finals placement 1973-2025 — 52 seasons; 2020 missing = COVID cancellation, and the shared engine auto-labels that gap) cross-merged with statembresults.php + statescholasticmbresults.php (the current pages added 2 rows mbhistory omits: the 2025 Scholastic B 5th-place tie incl. Eastern, Greentown, and Penn's city-qualified form). Every result row carries score:null + "placement" (published ordinal, standard competition ranking, real ties kept — 30 tie years verified); meta.json has series_kind:"placement" + score_note; records top/finals intentionally empty (no point scores exist). VALIDATION (all gates pass, enforced in-scraper before write): 1965 placement rows, 64 events, 172 bands; ranks standard-competition per class per event; zero duplicate rows (2 source dupes auto-dropped+logged); zero non-null scores; champions coverage complete for every expected year/class (A/B/C 1973+, D 1981+, Scholastic A/B 2013+, minus 2020). Identity threading: explicit alias table for printed variants (Coydon→Corydon Central, Evansville North→North Evansville, Jefferson Lafayette, New Castle Chrysler, Greenwood/Zionsville Community, Indpls./Ft. Wayne city spellings) plus a conservative bare-name→single-city merge (Penn→Penn Mishawaka etc.); 'Mount Vernon' (Posey Co.) and 'Mt. Vernon, Fortville' correctly kept as two schools. Season events use nominal sort dates (Oct 15 Scholastic Finals / Nov 1 State Finals) with date_display 'October/November YYYY' — the display never claims a day we don't know; Lucas Oil Stadium location set 2008+. UPCOMING: full fall 2026 round-by-round schedule (7 events, real dates, host sites) parsed from mbinfo.php#sites, written to upcoming.json AND seasons/2026.json (empty classes → engine renders them as upcoming), incl. Open Class State Finals Nov 7 2026 at Lucas Oil. Rankings season=2025 (movers/battles empty — one data point per season). Rerun path: python3 scraper/scrape_issma.py (5 fetches, gzip-cached under data/raw/www.issma.net/); rerun after each October/November for new results. FUTURE APPS: Indiana winter fans are NOT served by ISSMA (it runs no winter circuits) — IHSCGA winter guard (CompetitionSuite org 219C70AB-66F9-462B-AB0A-86A4B4F62CB5, 2013-2026 seasons) and IPA percussion/winds (org c196feef-4f95-4d62-a146-95b892a58f0a, 2017-2026) are both bridge-verified LIVE-READY with the existing scrape_compsuite.py pipeline, with full scores AND captions — strong candidate apps. Caution from the probe: GetCompetitionsBySeason resolves by season GUID alone; never mix org/season pairs.

ffcc.status: Live · 2022–26 full seasons + captions · archive to 2005
ffcc.captions: written — docs/ffcc/data/captions/ holds 5,537 judge-caption rows for 2022–2026 (every bridge season), all three activities on one superset column set with nulls: guard ge/ea/ma/da, percussion em/ev/mus/vis, concert percussion mus/art, winds oe/ma/va, plus pen/tot. Every row reconciles arithmetically AND matches the bridge total (non-reconciling rows dropped+logged). Archive-era pages (2005–2021) publish totals only, so no captions exist there. Note: guard's Movement caption is stored under key "ma", which the shared engine's CAPTION_DEFS labels "Music Analysis" — same key choice as the shipped WGASC app; the engine's pickable caption keys per activity are ge/ma (guard), mus/vis (perc), ma/va (winds), tot (all).
ffcc.notes: MECHANISM: scraper/scrape_ffcc.py (new; reuses shared common.fetch cache + scrape_compsuite.BRIDGE). Bridge era 2022–2026 via committed season GUIDs — 2024–2026 from the probe report, 2022 (14d44e8a-4213-44a2-8b0b-be49cda45d64, 40 comps) and 2023 (c03a5ae3-1d76-4340-90c2-1a96f593d935, 29 comps) recovered this session from Wayback copies of ffcc.org/event/* pages (each embeds its schedules.competitionsuite.com GUID, which doubles as the competition GUID) and verified live (org initials FFCC). Archive era via Wayback: WordPress inline pages (/scores/, /colorguard-scores/, /percussion-scores/, /winds-scores/?eventID=N; latest 200 snapshot per page) cover 2016–2021, and old /events/scores.php pages cover 2005–2012. DATASET: docs/ffcc/data/ — 368 events, 11,331 result rows, 860 ensembles, 16 seasons, LIVE marker written, meta.updated 2026-08-08 02:35 UTC. VALIDATION: all gates passed (script-checked): scores bounded 5–100, ranks recomputed hence sequential, dict-merge means no duplicate ensemble rows, standings sorted, caption arithmetic verified; ~30 zero-score DNS rows and a handful of non-reconciling caption rows dropped and logged (see run log). Championship "divisions" (sponsor-named parallel flights, e.g. "Scholastic AAA (Anastasia Division)") union into their base class and re-rank — so champions.json crowns one overall class winner where FFCC crowned one per division; 2018/2019 bare division-named rounds were class-resolved from the hosting page's event title. 2021 'SRA'-suffixed classes mapped to their base classes; old "Novice" mapped to "Cadet Novice"; "Class B" kept as a real historical guard class. GAPS (honest): seasons 2008, 2010, 2011, 2013–2015 have no archived score pages anywhere; archive-era coverage varies (2017: 8 events, 2005–2012: 3–12/season) — pre-2022 is "what the archive holds", 2022–2026 is complete per the circuit's own season lists; 2020 has no champions entry (COVID-cancelled championships — correctly absent); champions exist for 2006, 2012, 2016, 2018, 2019, 2021–2026. upcoming.json is [] (2026 season complete; 2027 not yet published). MAINTENANCE: new season = add one recap/schedule GUID to SEASONS in scrape_ffcc.py (Google-indexed within days of the first show) then --ingest --year Y; reruns are free (gzip cache under data/raw/). ffcc.org itself is SiteGround-captcha'd from this sandbox but never needed — bridge + recaps + Wayback are all open.
